lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct white vertical lines across the torso; spacing is approximately uniform in the mid-section and narrower toward the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed in the lower ventral segment of the third vertical line from the anterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Terminal line segments on the posterior haunch exhibit fragmentation and fail to reach the ventral midline.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two high-contrast circular spots located on the upper posterior hind limb.

other_distinctive_markers: Dark dorsal crest/mane; white patch on the lower throat; white spots on the mandible and below the eyes; white markings on the carpal joints.
